column1: # Alternation ceiling by data plane, and by whether adapter names share a prefix.
# The binding limit is NOT the same everywhere. Envoy refuses to compile a regex
# whose RE2 program size exceeds re2.max_program_size.error_level, and each
# Gateway API implementation picks that value:
#   istio 1.30.3     32768        (set in the proxy's runtime layer)
#   kgateway 2.1.1   unset        -> Envoy's compiled-in default of 100
# So kgateway is the outlier: two of three raise or remove the limit.
# Where the limit is not binding, the CRD's 4096-byte cap on a header match
